notes.title: 11-23Update
notes.content:
Hi, gentlemen friends, this is the updated log of the Valkyrie:
1. We fixed the following unattainable achievements: Monopoly 2, 3, 4 and Fashion 2, 3, 4
2. Fixed the wrong wearing problem of demon wing props
3. Fixed the problem that the angel wings could not be unlocked at 100 levels
4. Optimized the story in the game and DLC dubbing

notes.title: Join the community for a full game-featured experience
notes.content:
Hi gentlemen, how are you?

We have recently received some feedback from friends about game content, such as some game content cannot be loaded, etc., so in order to get a better game experience and solve some problems (you know), we recently opened a [b]Discord community[/ b], if you encounter any problems during the game, you can ask for help by joining the community.
Open with the community and our Twitter account where we'll be syncing game inquiries and event announcements later.
If you have more specific ideas and suggestions, you can also go to the Steam Support channel to report game or technical issues and contact our support.
[url=https://discord.gg/3YK9A2GEdS]>>>Click to join the Discord community<<<[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/dsgamex]>>>Click to visit the Twitter homepage<<<[/url]
Once you join the community, you can discuss game content with our enthusiastic players. Hope you can warm more people after you get help.
In the future, we will also operate the Twitter account and Discord community for a long time, and update the game consultation and hold events when the game is released. We will also host other more interesting community-specific events from time to time. Welcome to join and follow.

notes.title: The new game 《Valhalla：Awakening of Valkyrie》is coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello gentlemen!
This time, I bring you our partner Fantasy Games's new game - "Valhalla：Awakening of Valkyrie", which is a Nordic-themed match-3 game. In the game, you can play as Odin, riding your daughter. Valkyries, test their bodies and minds, and face the Ragnarok with them.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2094250/_/
You can also customize the image of the Valkyries in the game, change their outfits to your liking, further test their loyalty, and remember them forever.
At the same time, "Valhalla：Awakening of Valkyrie" also tries to redesign the match-3 gameplay. They added elements such as collecting items, terrain transmission, and terrain elimination to the levels, hoping to bring a different gaming experience to the gentlemen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42807057/afe1d842771946d8e694da8116980a2e45585044.gif[/img]
We hope that this game can be like a delicate dessert to bring gentlemen to a leisurely journey in Valhalla.
"Valhalla：Awakening of Valkyrie" will be launched in the near future, and the game can now be added to the wishlist.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42807057/9ef0e30d1d4c6c095f80f9564abe41f3dc625c92.gif[/img]
